name: ECS-24S
title: Switch Enterprise Campus 24S
summary: 24-port L3 stackable campus switch: 16x10GbE + 8x2.5GbE copper, 4x25G SFP28, dual PSUs, Etherlighting.

extra.qsfp28_note: 2x 100G QSFP28 are stacking-only, no uplink, no breakout
extra.odd: Hardware lists 'Power Output=yes' but no PoE ports/budget are specified — treated as non-PoE
extra.stacking_rule: up to 4 switches, same port count only

gotchas: No PoE — this is a non-PoE copper switch; for powered 10GbE access use USW-Pro-XG-24-PoE.
The two 100G QSFP28 ports are stacking-only: they cannot be used as uplinks and don't support breakout.
Full-depth 1U (496 mm) — needs a 4-post rack or center-mount shelf; 4 hot-swap fans mean noise.
Stacks only with switches of the same port count (max 4).
best_for: campus distribution with stacking and PSU redundancy
